method: Current appearance/v6 rigs; 30 current Female-named animation clips applied to each sex, 25 evenly spaced samples per clip plus rest; linear skinning with normalized four-influence weights. BVH overlap candidates include intentional neckline-facing and trim/body contact and are not a zero-clipping certificate. 12 representative posed front/back views per body visually reviewed, plus fishing and bucket-pour extreme contact views. Live CharacterCreation viewer checked for both sexes at idle and run.
body_coverage: Per-piece authored bind-space masks installed in CharacterCreation; preserve visible neckline, knees and thighs below skirt. No hairstyle tested; use No hair with fitted hats.
remaining_contacts: Fishing at about 8%: overhead hand crosses the hat crown/brim; requires an outfit-aware animation adjustment for full clearance.
Bucket-pour at about 58%: glove/hand contacts the side of the head.
Raw skirt/body overlap candidates occur at the inner hem during high knee poses; reviewed running/kicking/kneeling images are supplied. Cloth uses skeletal deformation, not simulation.

changes: Removed the female upperbody lower ivory roll so it cannot poke through the skirt.
Lowered both hats 0.04 metres and tailored their crown/brim to the skull silhouette.
checks: Zero skull/hat triangle overlaps in the rest pose for each sex.
Zero ivory waist faces on the female upperbody.
Regenerated and reviewed twelve front/back motion poses for each sex; female waist side close-up also reviewed.
All ten GLB files revalidated after export.
revision2.scope: The original 30-clip numeric audit is retained under QA/Revision1. Revision 2 uses the focused geometry checks and refreshed motion renders; original extreme-pose limitations still apply.

changes: Male pants refitted outside unmasked calves and ankles.
Boot shafts and ankle seam refitted over complete trousers.

checks.regions: Unmasked calf and ankle skin .12–.43 m; pants shell .114–.445 m; boot shaft/vamp .075–.425 m. Open hems and rolled contact rims excluded.

revision3.visual_review: Barefoot and booted rest, walk, run and kneel front and back; refreshed full-outfit 12-pose sheets.
revision3.scope: Focused lower-leg test; existing upperbody extreme-contact limitations remain.

changes: Raised the hidden toe/vamp underside above the outsole.
Lowered the tread to -0.019m and added sole support vertices for animated toe flex.
Used a common plantar skin-weight field through the lower foot layers.

Male.test: Bottom tread faces below -0.018m versus internal boot foot/toe surfaces and unmasked anatomical feet below 0.14m; all 30 clips at 25 samples plus rest. Sidewalls and the intentional upper/sole joining seam are outside this bottom-tread test.

Female.test: Bottom tread faces below -0.018m versus internal boot foot/toe surfaces and unmasked anatomical feet below 0.14m; all 30 clips at 25 samples plus rest. Sidewalls and the intentional upper/sole joining seam are outside this bottom-tread test.

sole_revision.scope: Bottom-tread regression test with unmasked feet, plus underside WalkV3 review. Original full-outfit limitations remain; all non-boot GLBs are unchanged.
